card.name: The digit 1 inside reference numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (or the word One) at the start or inside a number string such as an ISBN, DOI, ISSN or year, and sometimes a sentence-opening One.

modes.label: Digit 1 in identifiers
modes.description: The digit 1 sits inside a citation code such as an ISBN, DOI or ISSN.

modes.label: Digit 1 starting a number
modes.description: A 1 opens a year or section number in parentheses or brackets.

modes.label: Word One
modes.description: The word One opens a sentence or phrase such as "One example" or "One of the".

card.writes: It promotes odd word-piece tokens, so there is no clear output effect beyond continuing a digit string.
card.plain: It lights up on the digit 1 inside citation numbers like ISBNs and DOIs, and weakly on the word one.
